decisions.reason: The land had been left empty of people and animals (32:43; 33:10). God will scatter new life over it like a farmer sowing seed, so that it grows full again (Hosea 2:25; Ezekiel 36:9-11).

decisions.choice: the house of Israel and the house of Judah: both kingdoms, north and south
decisions.reason: The promise again includes both parts of the divided people, as the new covenant does (verse 31).

decisions.choice: Look, days are coming (Literal); The days are coming (Balanced); A time is coming (Readable)
decisions.reason: As elsewhere in Jeremiah (7:32; 9:24; 16:14).

decisions.choice: as a farmer sows a field with seed
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture of sowing.

decisions.choice: simiente de hombre
decisions.reason: *Adam* here stands beside "beast", so Literal keeps "hombre" in the general sense of humankind; Balanced and Readable say "personas" and "gente".

decisions.choice: "사람의 씨", with no gender span
decisions.reason: "사람" already includes everyone, so Korean has no second wording for the English gender setting.

decisions.choice: Eis que vêm dias (L); Vêm dias (B); Está chegando o tempo (R)
decisions.reason: The formula keeps the words 23:5 gives it at each level (also verse 38; 33:14), followed by "em que". Verse 31, which Hebrews 8:8 quotes, keeps Hebrews' Portuguese instead at Balanced and Readable ("Vem um tempo").

decisions.choice: {{gender:gente|homem}} (L)
decisions.reason: Literal follows the English setting with "gente" as the inclusive default and the traditional "homem" as the alternative; Balanced says "gente" without a setting, as the English Balanced says "people".

source.text: וְהָיָ֞ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֧ר שָׁקַ֣דְתִּי עֲלֵיהֶ֗ם לִנְת֧וֹשׁ וְלִנְת֛וֹץ וְלַהֲרֹ֖ס וּלְהַאֲבִ֣יד וּלְהָרֵ֑עַ כֵּ֣ן אֶשְׁקֹ֧ד עֲלֵיהֶ֛ם לִבְנ֥וֹת וְלִנְט֖וֹעַ נְאֻם־יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And it will be, just as I watched over them to uproot and to tear down and to overthrow and to destroy and to do harm, so I will watch over them to build and to plant, declares Yahweh.

en.L: And it will be, just as I watched over them to uproot and to tear down, and to overthrow and to destroy and to bring harm, so I will watch over them to build and to plant, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Just as I watched over them to uproot and to tear down, to overthrow, to destroy and to bring harm, so I will keep watch over them to build and to plant, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: In the past I kept watch over them to uproot and tear down, to overthrow, destroy and bring harm. Now I will keep watch over them to build and plant, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y sucederá que así como velé sobre ellos para arrancar y para derribar, y para derrocar, y para destruir, y para hacer mal, así velaré sobre ellos para edificar y para plantar, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: Así como velé sobre ellos para arrancar y derribar, para derrocar, destruir y hacer daño, así velaré sobre ellos para edificar y plantar, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: En el pasado estuve atento para arrancarlos y derribarlos, para derrocarlos, destruirlos y hacerles daño. Ahora estaré atento para edificarlos y plantarlos, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et il arrivera que, comme j’ai veillé sur eux pour arracher et pour démolir, pour renverser, pour détruire et pour faire du mal, ainsi je veillerai sur eux pour bâtir et pour planter, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Comme j’ai veillé sur eux pour arracher et démolir, pour renverser, détruire et faire du mal, ainsi je veillerai sur eux pour bâtir et planter, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Autrefois, j’ai veillé sur eux pour arracher et démolir, pour renverser, détruire et faire du mal. Maintenant je veillerai sur eux pour bâtir et planter, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Na itakuwa, kama nilivyowalinda ili kung'oa, na kubomoa, na kuangusha, na kuangamiza, na kuleta mabaya, ndivyo nitakavyowalinda ili kujenga na kupanda, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Kama nilivyowalinda ili kung'oa na kubomoa, kuangusha, kuangamiza na kuleta mabaya, ndivyo nitakavyowalinda ili kujenga na kupanda, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Zamani niliwalinda ili kung'oa na kubomoa, kuangusha, kuangamiza na kuleta mabaya. Sasa nitawalinda ili kujenga na kupanda, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Như {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã canh chừng chúng để nhổ đi, phá đổ, lật đổ, hủy diệt và giáng họa thể nào, thì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng sẽ canh chừng chúng để xây dựng và trồng thể ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.B: Như {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã canh chừng chúng để nhổ đi và phá đổ, để lật đổ, hủy diệt và giáng tai họa, thì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng sẽ canh chừng chúng để xây dựng và trồng, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.R: Xưa kia {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã canh chừng chúng để nhổ đi và phá đổ, để lật đổ, hủy diệt và giáng tai họa. Nay {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ canh chừng chúng để xây dựng và trồng, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.

ko.L: 그리고 내가 그들을 뽑고 허물고 무너뜨리고 멸하고 해를 끼치려고 지켜보았던 것처럼, 그들을 세우고 심으려고 지켜보겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다.
ko.B: 내가 그들을 뽑고 허물고 무너뜨리고 멸하고 재앙을 내리려고 지켜보았던 것처럼, 이제 그들을 세우고 심으려고 지켜보겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.
ko.R: 전에 나는 그들을 뽑고 허물고 무너뜨리고 멸하고 재앙을 내리려고 지켜보았다. 이제 나는 그들을 세우고 심으려고 지켜보겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.

pt.L: E será que, assim como vigiei sobre eles para arrancar e para derrubar, e para arrasar e para destruir e para fazer mal, assim vigiarei sobre eles para construir e para plantar, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.B: Assim como vigiei sobre eles para arrancar e derrubar, arrasar, destruir e trazer desgraça, assim vigiarei sobre eles para construir e plantar, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.R: No passado eu vigiei sobre eles para arrancar e derrubar, arrasar, destruir e trazer desgraça. Agora vou vigiar sobre eles para construir e plantar, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.

decisions.choice: uproot, tear down, overthrow, destroy, build, plant: the words of Jeremiah's call
decisions.reason: These are the verbs of 1:10, where God set Jeremiah over nations "to uproot and to tear down, to destroy and to overthrow, to build and to plant". Here "overthrow" comes before "destroy", and a fifth word of judgment is added: "to bring harm". The judgment Jeremiah announced has come; now the last two words come true.

decisions.choice: watched over them: God watching over his word to carry it out
decisions.reason: The verb is the one in 1:12, "I am watching over my word to do it", the word play on the almond tree. The same care that carried out the judgment will now carry out the restoration (compare 44:27).

decisions.choice: to bring harm: to bring disaster
decisions.reason: The verb means to do evil to, in the sense of causing harm or calamity, not wrongdoing.

decisions.choice: uproot, tear down, overthrow, destroy, build, plant
decisions.reason: Each level keeps the English verbs of 1:10 for the same Hebrew verbs, so the echo can be heard. The added verb is "bring harm".

decisions.choice: In the past ... Now
decisions.reason: Readable splits the comparison into two sentences and marks the change of time.

decisions.choice: arrancar, derribar, derrocar, destruir, edificar, plantar
decisions.reason: The verbs of Jeremiah's call keep the Spanish words of 1:10, 18:7-9 and 24:6 at every level, with "derrocar" for "overthrow" as in 1:10.

decisions.choice: kung'oa, kubomoa, kuangusha, kuangamiza; kujenga, kupanda
decisions.reason: The verbs of Jeremiah's call (1:10) in the Swahili used for them there and in 18:7-9 and 24:6, at every level: *natash* "kung'oa", *natats* "kubomoa", *haras* "kuangusha", *ʾabad* "kuangamiza".

decisions.choice: "arracher, démolir, renverser, détruire, bâtir, planter"
decisions.reason: The verbs of Jeremiah's call, kept as in 18:7-9 and 24:6, so the echo of 1:10 can be heard.

decisions.choice: "nhổ đi, phá đổ, lật đổ, hủy diệt ... xây dựng và trồng"
decisions.reason: All six verbs of Jeremiah's call in one sentence, worded as in 18:7-9 and 24:6.

decisions.choice: "뽑다, 허물다, 무너뜨리다, 멸하다, 세우다, 심다"
decisions.reason: The words of Jeremiah's call (1:10), with the same Korean verbs as at 18:7-9 and 24:6 (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: vigiar; arrancar, derrubar, arrasar, destruir, construir, plantar
decisions.reason: The six verbs keep the Portuguese words Jeremiah 1:10 set for the book, each for its own Hebrew verb, and "vigiar" is the verb of 1:12 ("estou vigiando a minha palavra"), so both echoes of Jeremiah's call are heard (m1, m2). The added verb is "fazer mal" (L), "trazer desgraça" (B, R): harm, not wrongdoing (m3).

source.text: בַּיָּמִ֣ים הָהֵ֔ם לֹא־יֹאמְר֣וּ ע֔וֹד אָב֖וֹת אָ֣כְלוּ בֹ֑סֶר וְשִׁנֵּ֥י בָנִ֖ים תִּקְהֶֽינָה׃

records.literal_gloss: In the days the those they will not say again: Fathers have eaten sour grape[s], and [the] teeth of [the] children are blunted.

en.L: In those days they will no longer say, "Fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the teeth of the children are blunted."
en.B: In those days people will no longer say, "The {{gender:parents|fathers}} ate sour grapes, but it is the children whose teeth are set on edge."
en.R: At that time people will no longer say, "The {{gender:parents|fathers}} ate the sour grapes, but the children got the sour taste."

es.L: En aquellos días no dirán más: «Los padres comieron uvas agrias, y los dientes de los hijos tienen dentera».
es.B: En aquellos días la gente ya no dirá: «Los padres comieron uvas agrias, pero son los hijos los que tienen dentera».
es.R: En ese tiempo la gente ya no dirá: «Los padres comieron las uvas agrias, pero los hijos se quedaron con el sabor amargo».

fr.L: En ces jours-là, on ne dira plus : « Les pères ont mangé des raisins verts, et les dents des enfants sont agacées. »
fr.B: En ces jours-là, on ne dira plus : « Les {{gender:parents|pères}} ont mangé des raisins verts, mais ce sont les enfants qui ont les dents agacées. »
fr.R: En ce temps-là, les gens ne diront plus : « Les {{gender:parents|pères}} ont mangé des raisins pas mûrs, mais ce sont les enfants qui en ont le goût aigre dans la bouche. »

sw.L: Katika siku zile hawatasema tena, "Baba wamekula zabibu chachu, na meno ya watoto yametiwa ganzi."
sw.B: Katika siku hizo watu hawatasema tena, "Wazazi walikula zabibu chachu, lakini ni watoto ambao meno yao yametiwa ganzi."
sw.R: Wakati huo watu hawatasema tena, "Wazazi walikula zabibu chachu, lakini watoto ndio walioonja uchachu."

vi.L: Trong những ngày ấy, người ta sẽ không còn nói: "Cha ăn nho chua, mà răng con ê."
vi.B: Trong những ngày ấy, người ta sẽ không còn nói: "Cha mẹ ăn nho chua, mà con cái lại bị ê răng."
vi.R: Vào thời ấy, người ta sẽ không còn nói: "Cha mẹ ăn nho chua, mà con cái lại bị ê răng."

ko.L: 그날에 그들은 다시는 "아버지들이 신 포도를 먹었는데, 자식들의 이가 시리다." 하고 말하지 않을 것이다.
ko.B: 그때에는 사람들이 다시는 "{{gender:부모가|아버지들이}} 신 포도를 먹었는데, 이가 시린 것은 자식들이다." 하고 말하지 않을 것이다.
ko.R: 그때에는 사람들이 다시는 "{{gender:부모가|아버지들이}} 신 포도를 먹었는데, 신맛은 자식들이 느낀다." 하고 말하지 않을 것이다.

pt.L: Naqueles dias não dirão mais: "Pais comeram uvas verdes, e os dentes dos filhos ficaram embotados."
pt.B: Naqueles dias as pessoas não dirão mais: "Os pais comeram uvas verdes, mas são os filhos que ficaram com os dentes ásperos."
pt.R: Naquele tempo as pessoas não vão mais dizer: "Os pais comeram as uvas verdes, mas foram os filhos que ficaram com o gosto azedo na boca."

decisions.choice: the fathers ate sour grapes, and the children's teeth are blunted: a proverb that the children suffer for their parents' sins
decisions.reason: Unripe grapes leave a rough, dull feeling on the teeth. The proverb complained that the generation of the exile was being punished for what earlier generations had done (Lamentations 5:7; compare 2 Kings 24:3-4).

decisions.choice: the same proverb in Ezekiel 18:2
decisions.reason: Ezekiel quotes the same saying among the exiles and answers it at length: each person who sins will die for their own sin (Ezekiel 18:3-4, 20).

decisions.choice: blunted: made dull, set on edge
decisions.reason: The verb describes the dull, rough feeling of teeth after something sour.

decisions.choice: parents (with fathers as the alternative)
decisions.reason: The proverb speaks of the older generation as a whole; the gender setting gives "fathers" as the alternative. Literal keeps "fathers".

decisions.choice: set on edge (Balanced); got the sour taste (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced uses the English phrase for the feeling; Readable says it plainly.

decisions.choice: los padres
decisions.reason: Spanish "padres" already means "parents", so it needs no gender span where the English has one.

decisions.choice: wazazi
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "wazazi" (parents), as the English default does; Swahili has no setting span here because "wazazi" is simply the word for parents, and Literal keeps "baba".

decisions.choice: "cha mẹ" (parents), with no gender span
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "cha mẹ", which is the natural Vietnamese for the proverb's meaning; the Literal "cha" keeps the Hebrew word. There is no second wording that a setting would switch to.

decisions.choice: "{{gender:부모가|아버지들이}}"
decisions.reason: As the English: the proverb is about parents and children (meaning decision m1), with "fathers" as the literal alternative. Literal keeps "아버지들", as the English Literal keeps "Fathers".

decisions.choice: "이가 시리다" (L, B); "신맛을 느끼다" (R)
decisions.reason: The Korean idiom for teeth set on edge by sourness says what the Hebrew "blunted" means (meaning decision m3).

decisions.choice: os pais, with no gender setting
decisions.reason: The English needs a setting to choose between "parents" and "fathers". Portuguese "os pais" already means father and mother together, as in everyday speech, so no setting is needed; the proverb (m1) keeps the plain family word.

decisions.choice: ficaram embotados (L); ficaram com os dentes ásperos (B); o gosto azedo na boca (R)
decisions.reason: The verb is the dull, rough feeling of teeth after something sour (m3). Literal keeps "embotados"; Balanced says "ásperos", how Portuguese describes teeth after unripe fruit; Readable says it plainly, as the English does.

source.text: כִּ֛י אִם־אִ֥ישׁ בַּעֲוֺנ֖וֹ יָמ֑וּת כָּל־הָֽאָדָ֛ם הָאֹכֵ֥ל הַבֹּ֖סֶר תִּקְהֶ֥ינָה שִׁנָּֽיו׃ס

records.literal_gloss: But each for his own iniquity will die; every man who eats the sour grape[s], his teeth will be blunted.

en.L: But each one will die for {{gender:their|his}} own iniquity; every {{gender:person|man}} who eats the sour grapes, {{gender:their|his}} teeth will be blunted.
en.B: Instead, each will die for {{gender:their|his}} own guilt; whoever eats the sour grapes, it is {{gender:their|his}} own teeth that will be set on edge.
en.R: Instead, people will die for their own sins. Whoever eats sour grapes will get the sour taste in {{gender:their|his}} own mouth.

es.L: Sino que cada uno morirá por su propia iniquidad; toda persona que coma las uvas agrias tendrá dentera.
es.B: Más bien, cada uno morirá por su propia culpa; el que coma las uvas agrias, ese tendrá dentera.
es.R: Más bien, cada persona morirá por sus propios pecados. El que coma uvas agrias tendrá el sabor amargo en su propia boca.

fr.L: Mais chacun mourra pour sa propre iniquité ; tout {{gender:être humain|homme}} qui mangera des raisins verts, ses dents seront agacées.
fr.B: Au contraire, chacun mourra pour sa propre faute ; celui qui mangera des raisins verts, ce sont ses propres dents qui seront agacées.
fr.R: Au contraire, chacun mourra pour ses propres péchés. Celui qui mangera des raisins pas mûrs en aura lui-même le goût aigre dans la bouche.

sw.L: Bali kila mmoja atakufa kwa uovu wake mwenyewe; kila mtu alaye zabibu chachu, meno yake yatatiwa ganzi.
sw.B: Badala yake, kila mmoja atakufa kwa hatia yake mwenyewe; yeyote alaye zabibu chachu, ni meno yake mwenyewe yatakayotiwa ganzi.
sw.R: Badala yake, watu watakufa kwa dhambi zao wenyewe. Yeyote atakayekula zabibu chachu ataonja uchachu kinywani mwake mwenyewe.

vi.L: Nhưng ai nấy sẽ chết vì tội ác của chính mình; ai ăn nho chua, thì răng người ấy sẽ ê.
vi.B: Thay vào đó, ai nấy sẽ chết vì tội lỗi của chính mình; ai ăn nho chua thì chính răng người ấy sẽ bị ê.
vi.R: Thay vào đó, ai cũng sẽ chết vì tội lỗi của chính mình. Ai ăn nho chua thì chính người ấy sẽ bị ê răng.

ko.L: 오히려 각 사람이 자기 죄악 때문에 죽을 것이다. 신 포도를 먹는 사람마다 자기 이가 시릴 것이다.
ko.B: 오히려 각 사람이 자기 허물 때문에 죽을 것이다. 신 포도를 먹는 사람은 누구나 자기 이가 시릴 것이다.
ko.R: 오히려 사람들은 저마다 자기 죄 때문에 죽을 것이다. 신 포도를 먹는 사람은 누구나 자기 입에서 신맛을 느낄 것이다.

pt.L: Mas cada um morrerá pela sua própria iniquidade; todo {{gender:aquele|homem}} que comer as uvas verdes, os seus dentes ficarão embotados.
pt.B: Pelo contrário, cada um morrerá pela sua própria culpa: quem comer as uvas verdes é que ficará com os dentes ásperos.
pt.R: Pelo contrário, cada pessoa vai morrer pelos próprios pecados. Quem comer uvas verdes é que vai ficar com o gosto azedo na boca.

decisions.choice: each will die for their own iniquity: everyone answers for their own sin
decisions.reason: The new age will make plain that God judges each person for their own wrong (Deuteronomy 24:16; Ezekiel 18:20). The verse does not deny that sin harms later generations; it denies that the innocent bear another's guilt before God.

decisions.choice: iniquity: wrongdoing and the guilt it brings
decisions.reason: The word covers both the wrong done and the guilt and punishment that follow.

decisions.choice: iniquity (Literal); guilt (Balanced); sins (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in Isaiah.

decisions.choice: their, person (with his, man as the alternatives)
decisions.reason: "Each" and "every man" here mean every person, man or woman; the gender setting gives the traditional forms.

decisions.choice: "tout être humain", with "tout homme" as the gender alternative; "chacun ... sa" and "celui qui ... ses" with no span
decisions.reason: As the style guide: the setting goes on the noun French must choose ('adam / 'ish meaning anyone); "chacun" and "celui qui" are already generic, so the possessives that refer to them need none.

decisions.choice: "ai nấy ... người ấy" with no gender span
decisions.reason: Vietnamese "ai" and "người ấy" are already inclusive, so the English gender alternatives have no Vietnamese counterpart here or in verse 34.

decisions.choice: "각 사람", "자기", with no gender span
decisions.reason: Korean "각 사람" and "자기" are already inclusive, so the English gender alternatives have no Korean counterpart.

decisions.choice: iniquidade (L); culpa (B); pecados (R)
decisions.reason: As Isaiah sets the word (22:14; 40:2): "iniquidade" at Literal, "culpa" at Balanced, "pecado" at Readable.

decisions.choice: todo aquele (L), with "homem" as the alternative; no setting at B and R
decisions.reason: Portuguese "cada um", "seus" and "quem" already include men and women, so the English "their/his" spans need no counterpart; Literal keeps one setting on the noun the Hebrew has, "every man", with "todo aquele" as the default.

source.text: הִנֵּ֛ה יָמִ֥ים בָּאִ֖ים נְאֻם־יְהוָ֑ה וְכָרַתִּ֗י אֶת־בֵּ֧ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל וְאֶת־בֵּ֥ית יְהוּדָ֖ה בְּרִ֥ית חֲדָשָֽׁה׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, days [are] coming, declares Yahweh, when I will make with [the] house of Israel and with [the] house of Judah a covenant new,

en.L: Look, days are coming, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, when I will make with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah a new covenant,
en.B: The days are coming, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and then I will make a covenant with the house of Israel and the house of Judah: a new covenant.
en.R: A time is coming, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, when I will make a new covenant with the people of Israel and the people of Judah.

es.L: He aquí vienen días, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, en que haré con la casa de Israel y con la casa de Judá un pacto nuevo,
es.B: Vienen días, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, en que haré un pacto con la casa de Israel y con la casa de Judá: un pacto nuevo.
es.R: Se acerca el tiempo, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, en que haré un pacto nuevo con el pueblo de Israel y el pueblo de Judá.

fr.L: Voici, des jours viennent, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, où je conclurai avec la maison d’Israël et avec la maison de Juda une alliance nouvelle,
fr.B: Des jours viennent, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, où je conclurai une alliance avec la maison d’Israël et la maison de Juda : une alliance nouvelle.
fr.R: Un temps vient, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, où je ferai une alliance nouvelle avec le peuple d’Israël et le peuple de Juda.

sw.L: Tazama, siku zinakuja, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nitakapofanya na nyumba ya Israeli na nyumba ya Yuda agano jipya,
sw.B: Siku zinakuja, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ndipo nitafanya agano na nyumba ya Israeli na nyumba ya Yuda: agano jipya.
sw.R: Wakati unakuja, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nitakapofanya agano jipya na watu wa Israeli na watu wa Yuda.

vi.L: Kìa, những ngày đang đến, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ lập với nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên và với nhà Giu-đa một giao ước mới,
vi.B: Sẽ đến những ngày, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ lập một giao ước với nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên và nhà Giu-đa, một giao ước mới.
vi.R: Sẽ đến lúc, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ lập một giao ước mới với dân Y-sơ-ra-ên và dân Giu-đa.

ko.L: 보아라, 날들이 온다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다. 그때에 내가 이스라엘 집과 유다 집과 새 언약을 맺겠다.
ko.B: 때가 오고 있다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 그때에 내가 이스라엘 집과 유다 집과 언약을 맺을 것이니, 그것은 새 언약이다.
ko.R: 때가 오고 있다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 그때에 내가 이스라엘 백성과 유다 백성과 새 언약을 맺겠다.

pt.L: Eis que vêm dias, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, em que farei com a casa de Israel e com a casa de Judá uma aliança nova,
pt.B: Vem um tempo, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, em que estabelecerei uma aliança com a casa de Israel e com a casa de Judá: uma nova aliança.
pt.R: Vem um tempo, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, em que vou fazer uma nova aliança com o povo de Israel e com o povo de Judá.

decisions.choice: a new covenant: a new binding relationship between God and his people
decisions.reason: A covenant is a solemn agreement that binds two parties, here God and Israel. The covenant made at Sinai had been broken (verse 32; 11:10). God promises a new one, described in verses 33-34; it is the only place in the Hebrew Scriptures where the phrase "new covenant" occurs.

decisions.choice: make a covenant: literally "cut" a covenant
decisions.reason: The Hebrew verb is "cut", probably from the rite of cutting animals in two when a covenant was made (34:18; Genesis 15:9-18).

decisions.choice: used in the New Testament: Hebrews 8:8-12; 10:16-17; Luke 22:20; 1 Corinthians 11:25
decisions.reason: Hebrews quotes verses 31-34 in full, and again in part, to show that the covenant made through Christ fulfills this promise. At the Last Supper Jesus speaks of the cup as "the new covenant in my blood". These are New Testament readings of the promise; in Jeremiah it is made to the house of Israel and the house of Judah.

decisions.choice: the sentence continues into verse 32
decisions.reason: Verse 32 goes on to say what the new covenant will not be like.

decisions.choice: and then I will make a covenant ... a new covenant
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the Hebrew order, with "new covenant" at the end of the sentence where the Hebrew puts it, and repeats "covenant" to make that order natural. "And then" gives the Hebrew "and" that joins the promise to the coming days.

decisions.choice: the people of Israel and the people of Judah
decisions.reason: Readable says "the people of" for "the house of".

decisions.choice: un pacto nuevo con la casa de Israel y con la casa de Judá (Literal, Balanced); un pacto nuevo con el pueblo de Israel y el pueblo de Judá (Readable)
decisions.reason: The wording the terms note sets, keeping the key terms of the published Hebrews 8:8 ("pacto nuevo", "la casa de Israel", "la casa de Judá") without copying its Greek-based wording.

decisions.choice: agano jipya; nyumba ya Israeli na nyumba ya Yuda
decisions.reason: Hebrews 8:8-12 quotes 31:31-34, so the key terms of the published Swahili there are kept ("agano jipya", "nyumba ya Israeli na nyumba ya Yuda", "Mjue BWANA", "tangu aliye mdogo hadi aliye mkubwa"); the rest is drafted from the Hebrew, which Hebrews reads through the Greek.

decisions.choice: "une alliance nouvelle" at every level, with "la maison d'Israël et la maison de Juda"
decisions.reason: As the terms note sets: Hebrews 8:8 quotes this verse, and the French of Hebrews says "une alliance nouvelle"; keeping its key words lets a reader see the quotation.

decisions.choice: "Voici, des jours viennent" (L); "Des jours viennent" (B); "Un temps vient" (R)
decisions.reason: The wording the terms note sets for this phrase, close to Hebrews 8:8 in French.

decisions.choice: "giao ước mới với nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên và nhà Giu-đa" (L, B); "với dân Y-sơ-ra-ên và dân Giu-đa" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's wording, keeping the key terms of the published Hebrews 8:8 so that a reader can see the quotation; Hebrews has "Chúa phán", Jeremiah "CHÚA phán vậy". Verses 31-34 are drafted from the Hebrew, not from Hebrews' Greek.

decisions.choice: "새 언약"; "날들이 온다" (L), "때가 오고 있다" (B, R); "이스라엘 집과 유다 집"
decisions.reason: The terms note's key terms for 31:31-34, so the reader can see the quotation in Hebrews 8:8-12 (meaning decision m3); the sentences are drafted from the Hebrew, not copied from the published Hebrews.

decisions.choice: "언약을 맺다" for "cut a covenant"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew idiom (meaning decision m2) is said with the ordinary Korean verb for making a covenant at every level.

decisions.choice: Hebrews 8:8's Portuguese kept: Eis que vêm dias; uma aliança nova (L); Vem um tempo ... em que estabelecerei (B); vou fazer uma nova aliança (R)
decisions.reason: Hebrews 8:8-12 quotes verses 31-34 (m3), and the words of its Portuguese are kept where the Hebrew allows. The differences: Jeremiah has the divine name and ne'um, "declara o SENHOR" (L, B), where Hebrews has "diz [o] Senhor"; Literal says "farei", for the Hebrew "cut" a covenant (m2), where Hebrews' Greek has "levarei a termo"; Balanced keeps the Hebrew order, ending with "uma nova aliança", as the English does; Readable says "o povo de Israel" for "the house of", as the English Readable does. Balanced and Readable say "Vem um tempo", as Hebrews does, where verses 27 and 38 and 23:5 say "Vêm dias" and "Está chegando o tempo": the two wordings say the same, and the quotation is kept recognisable.

source.text: לֹ֣א כַבְּרִ֗ית אֲשֶׁ֤ר כָּרַ֨תִּי֙ אֶת־אֲבוֹתָ֔ם בְּיוֹם֙ הֶחֱזִיקִ֣י בְיָדָ֔ם לְהוֹצִיאָ֖ם מֵאֶ֖רֶץ מִצְרָ֑יִם אֲשֶׁר־הֵ֜מָּה הֵפֵ֣רוּ אֶת־בְּרִיתִ֗י וְאָנֹכִ֛י בָּעַ֥לְתִּי בָ֖ם נְאֻם־יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: not like the covenant that I made with their fathers in [the] day of my taking hold of their hand to bring them out from [the] land of Egypt, which they, they broke my covenant, and I, I was husband over them, declares Yahweh.

en.L: not like the covenant that I made with their fathers on the day I took them by the hand to bring them out of the land of Egypt, {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} covenant that they broke, though I was a husband to them, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: It will not be like the covenant I made with their ancestors on the day I took their hand to lead them out from the land of Egypt. They broke {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} covenant, though I was their husband, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: It will not be like the covenant I made with their ancestors when I took them by the hand and led them out of Egypt. They broke that covenant, even though I was like a husband to them, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: no como el pacto que hice con sus padres el día que los tomé de la mano para sacarlos de la tierra de Egipto, {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pacto que ellos quebrantaron, aunque yo fui un esposo para ellos, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: No será como el pacto que hice con sus antepasados el día en que los tomé de la mano para sacarlos de la tierra de Egipto. Ellos quebrantaron {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pacto, aunque yo era su esposo, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: No será como el pacto que hice con sus antepasados cuando los tomé de la mano y los saqué de Egipto. Ellos rompieron ese pacto, aunque yo era como un esposo para ellos, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: non comme l’alliance que j’ai conclue avec leurs pères au jour où je les ai pris par la main pour les faire sortir du pays d’Égypte, {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} alliance qu’eux ont rompue, alors que j’étais leur époux, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Elle ne sera pas comme l’alliance que j’ai conclue avec leurs {{gender:ancêtres|pères}} le jour où je les ai pris par la main pour les faire sortir du pays d’Égypte. Ils ont rompu {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} alliance, alors que j’étais leur époux, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Elle ne sera pas comme l’alliance que j’ai faite avec leurs {{gender:ancêtres|pères}} quand je les ai pris par la main et que je les ai fait sortir d’Égypte. Ils ont rompu cette alliance, alors que j’étais pour eux comme un mari, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: si kama agano nililofanya na baba zao siku nilipowashika mkono ili kuwatoa katika nchi ya Misri, agano {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} ambalo wao walilivunja, ingawa {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} nilikuwa mume kwao, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Halitakuwa kama agano nililofanya na babu zao siku ile nilipowashika mkono kuwaongoza kutoka nchi ya Misri. Walilivunja agano {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}}, ingawa nilikuwa mume wao, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Halitakuwa kama agano nililofanya na babu zao nilipowashika mkono na kuwaongoza kutoka Misri. Walilivunja agano lile, ingawa nilikuwa kama mume kwao, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: không giống như giao ước {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã lập với tổ phụ họ trong ngày {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nắm tay họ để đem họ ra khỏi xứ Ai Cập, là giao ước của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mà họ đã phá vỡ, dù {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là chồng của họ, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.B: Giao ước ấy sẽ không giống như giao ước {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã lập với tổ tiên họ trong ngày {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nắm tay dẫn họ ra khỏi xứ Ai Cập. Họ đã phá vỡ giao ước của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, dù {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là chồng của họ, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.R: Giao ước ấy sẽ không giống như giao ước {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã lập với tổ tiên họ khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nắm tay dẫn họ ra khỏi Ai Cập. Họ đã phá vỡ giao ước ấy, dù {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đối với họ như một người chồng, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.

ko.L: 그것은 내가 그들의 조상들의 손을 잡고 이집트 땅에서 이끌어 내던 날에 그들과 맺은 언약과 같지 않을 것이다. 내가 그들의 남편이었는데도, 그들은 내 언약을 깨뜨렸다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다.
ko.B: 그것은 내가 그들의 조상들의 손을 잡고 이집트 땅에서 이끌어 낸 날에 그들과 맺은 언약과는 다를 것이다. 내가 그들의 남편이었는데도 그들은 내 언약을 깨뜨렸다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.
ko.R: 그 언약은 내가 그들의 조상들의 손을 잡고 이집트에서 이끌어 낼 때에 맺은 언약과 같지 않을 것이다. 나는 그들에게 남편과 같았는데도, 그들은 그 언약을 깨뜨렸다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.

pt.L: não como a aliança que fiz com os pais deles no dia em que os tomei pela mão para tirá-los da terra do Egito, a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} aliança que eles romperam, embora eu fosse um marido para eles, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.B: Ela será diferente da aliança que fiz com os antepassados deles no dia em que os tomei pela mão para tirá-los da terra do Egito. Eles romperam a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} aliança, embora eu fosse o marido deles, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.R: Ela não vai ser como a aliança que fiz com os antepassados deles, quando os tomei pela mão e os tirei do Egito. Eles romperam aquela aliança, mesmo eu tendo sido como um marido para eles, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.

decisions.choice: the covenant made with their fathers at the exodus: the covenant of Sinai
decisions.reason: God made his covenant with Israel at Mount Sinai after bringing them out of Egypt (Exodus 19:4-6; 24:3-8). Jeremiah has already charged the people with breaking it (11:3-10).

decisions.choice: took them by the hand: led them as a parent leads a child
decisions.reason: The picture is of tender guidance (Hosea 11:1-3), not force.

decisions.choice: I was a husband to them: God bound to Israel as husband, and so also as master
decisions.reason: The verb means to marry, to be a husband, and so to be lord or master over someone (3:14; Isaiah 54:5). It sets Israel's breaking of the covenant against God's faithfulness as a husband. The Greek translation, which Hebrews 8:9 quotes, reads "and I turned away from them" (or "I did not care for them"), perhaps from a Hebrew word that differs by one letter.

decisions.choice: though I was a husband: a contrast between their unfaithfulness and God's faithfulness
decisions.reason: The Hebrew sets "they" against "I": they broke the covenant, and yet I was their husband.

decisions.choice: fathers (Literal); ancestors (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Here "fathers" means the earlier generations.

decisions.choice: like a husband
decisions.reason: Readable marks the picture as a comparison.

decisions.choice: "남편"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew pictures God as Israel's husband (meaning decision m3); Korean keeps the marriage picture, which Hebrews 8:9, following the Greek, does not have.

decisions.choice: Verse 31 closed as a sentence and verse 32 begun with "그것은"
decisions.reason: Korean cannot carry "not like the covenant" after the main verb of verse 31, so verse 32 opens with "그것은" (meaning decision m4 of 31:31).

decisions.choice: Hebrews 8:9's Portuguese kept to "terra do Egito"; then romperam ... embora eu fosse um marido para eles
alternatives: eles não permaneceram na minha aliança, e eu os desconsiderei
decisions.reason: The first part keeps Hebrews 8:9's words ("não como a aliança que fiz com os pais deles no dia em que os tomei pela mão para tirá-los da terra do Egito"; "Ela será diferente" at Balanced). The end differs because Hebrews follows the Greek, "they did not continue in my covenant, and I disregarded them", while the Hebrew says that they broke it though God was their husband (m3, m4). The ancestors are "os antepassados" at Balanced and Readable with no gender setting, since the English has none here.

source.text: כִּ֣י זֹ֣את הַבְּרִ֡ית אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֶכְרֹת֩ אֶת־בֵּ֨ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל אַחֲרֵ֨י הַיָּמִ֤ים הָהֵם֙ נְאֻם־יְהוָ֔ה נָתַ֤תִּי אֶת־תּֽוֹרָתִי֙ בְּקִרְבָּ֔ם וְעַל־לִבָּ֖ם אֶכְתֲּבֶ֑נָּה וְהָיִ֤יתִי לָהֶם֙ לֵֽאלֹהִ֔ים וְהֵ֖מָּה יִֽהְיוּ־לִ֥י לְעָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: For this [is] the covenant that I will make with [the] house of Israel after the days the those, declares Yahweh: I will put my instruction within them, and on their heart I will write it; and I will be to them for God, and they, they will be to me for a people.

en.L: For this [is] the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: I will put {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} instruction within them, and on their heart I will write it; and I will be their God, and they will be {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people.
en.B: Rather, this will be the covenant that I make with the house of Israel when those days are past, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: I will set {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} instruction deep inside them and write it on their hearts. I will be their God, and they will be {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people.
en.R: But this is the new covenant I will make with the people of Israel after that time, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: I will put {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} teaching inside them and write it on their hearts. I will be their God, and they will be {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} people.

es.L: Porque este [es] el pacto que haré con la casa de Israel después de aquellos días, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: Pondré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} ley dentro de ellos, y sobre su corazón la escribiré; y yo seré su Dios, y ellos serán {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo.
es.B: Este será, en cambio, el pacto que haré con la casa de Israel cuando hayan pasado aquellos días, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: Pondré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} ley en lo más profundo de su ser y la escribiré en su corazón. Yo seré su Dios, y ellos serán {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo.
es.R: Pero este es el pacto nuevo que haré con el pueblo de Israel después de ese tiempo, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: Pondré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} enseñanza dentro de ellos y la escribiré en su corazón. Yo seré su Dios, y ellos serán {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} pueblo.

fr.L: Car voici l’alliance que je conclurai avec la maison d’Israël après ces jours-là, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : Je mettrai {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} loi au-dedans d’eux, et sur leur cœur je l’écrirai ; et je serai leur Dieu, et ils seront {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple.
fr.B: Voici plutôt l’alliance que je conclurai avec la maison d’Israël quand ces jours-là seront passés, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : Je placerai {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} instruction au plus profond d’eux et je l’écrirai sur leur cœur. Je serai leur Dieu, et ils seront {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple.
fr.R: Mais voici l’alliance nouvelle que je ferai avec le peuple d’Israël après ce temps-là, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : Je mettrai {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} enseignement en eux et je l’écrirai sur leur cœur. Je serai leur Dieu, et ils seront {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} peuple.

sw.L: Kwa maana hili [ndilo] agano nitakalofanya na nyumba ya Israeli baada ya siku zile, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}: Nitaweka sheria {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} ndani yao, na juu ya moyo wao nitaiandika; nami nitakuwa Mungu wao, nao watakuwa watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}.
sw.B: Bali hili ndilo agano nitakalofanya na nyumba ya Israeli siku hizo zitakapopita, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}: Nitaweka sheria {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} ndani kabisa yao na kuiandika mioyoni mwao. Nitakuwa Mungu wao, nao watakuwa watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}.
sw.R: Lakini hili ndilo agano jipya nitakalofanya na watu wa Israeli baada ya wakati huo, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}: Nitaweka mafundisho {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} ndani yao na kuyaandika mioyoni mwao. Nitakuwa Mungu wao, nao watakuwa watu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}.

vi.L: Vì đây [là] giao ước {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ lập với nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên sau những ngày ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy: Ta sẽ đặt luật pháp của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trong họ, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ ghi luật ấy trên lòng họ; {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ là Đức Chúa Trời của họ, và họ sẽ là dân của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.B: Nhưng đây là giao ước {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ lập với nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên khi những ngày ấy qua đi, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy: Ta sẽ đặt luật pháp của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sâu trong họ và khắc ghi trên lòng họ. Ta sẽ là Đức Chúa Trời của họ, và họ sẽ là dân của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.R: Nhưng đây là giao ước mới {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ lập với dân Y-sơ-ra-ên sau thời ấy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: Ta sẽ đặt lời dạy của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} vào bên trong họ và viết lời ấy trên lòng họ. Ta sẽ là Đức Chúa Trời của họ, và họ sẽ là dân của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.

ko.L: 그날들 뒤에 내가 이스라엘 집과 맺을 언약은 이것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다. 내가 내 가르침을 그들 속에 두고, 그들의 마음에 그것을 기록하겠다. 나는 그들의 하나님이 되고, 그들은 내 백성이 될 것이다.
ko.B: 그날들이 지나간 뒤에 내가 이스라엘 집과 맺을 언약은 이러하다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 내가 내 가르침을 그들 속 깊이 두고, 그들의 마음에 새기겠다. 나는 그들의 하나님이 되고, 그들은 내 백성이 될 것이다.
ko.R: 그때가 지난 뒤에 내가 이스라엘 백성과 맺을 새 언약은 이러하다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 내가 내 가르침을 그들 속에 넣어 주고, 그들의 마음에 새겨 주겠다. 나는 그들의 하나님이 되고, 그들은 내 백성이 될 것이다.

pt.L: Pois esta [é] a aliança que firmarei com a casa de Israel depois daqueles dias, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: porei a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} instrução dentro deles, e sobre o coração deles a escreverei; e serei o Deus deles, e eles serão o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo.
pt.B: Pois esta é a aliança que farei com a casa de Israel quando aqueles dias tiverem passado, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: porei a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} instrução bem dentro deles e a gravarei no coração deles. Eu serei o Deus deles, e eles serão o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo.
pt.R: Esta é a nova aliança que vou fazer com o povo de Israel quando chegar esse tempo, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: vou pôr o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} ensino dentro deles e vou escrevê-lo no coração deles. Eu serei o Deus deles, e eles serão o {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} povo.

decisions.choice: my instruction: God's teaching, the law given in the covenant
decisions.reason: The word means instruction or teaching, and is the name for the law of Moses. The new covenant does not bring a new law; it puts God's own teaching inside his people. Hebrews 8:10 has "my laws".

decisions.choice: within them, on their heart: obedience from the inside
decisions.reason: The old covenant was written on tablets of stone (Exodus 24:12; 31:18); the people's sin was written on their hearts (17:1). Now God himself will write his teaching on the heart, the seat of thought and will, so that they want to do it (24:7; 32:39-40; Ezekiel 36:26-27).

decisions.choice: I will be their God, and they will be my people: the covenant promise kept at last
decisions.reason: The aim of the covenant from the beginning (Exodus 6:7; Leviticus 26:12; Jeremiah 7:23; 31:1) is now reached.

decisions.choice: after those days: in the time to come
decisions.reason: "Those days" are the days of verse 31. The phrase points to the future, when the judgment is over.

decisions.choice: the house of Israel: the whole reunited people
decisions.reason: Only Israel is named here, but after verse 31 it means the whole people, Israel and Judah together.

decisions.choice: instruction (Literal, Balanced); teaching (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in Isaiah.

decisions.choice: the new covenant
decisions.reason: Readable adds "new" to link back to verse 31.

decisions.choice: mi ley
decisions.reason: Here *torah* is "ley" at Literal and Balanced, not "instrucción", because the terms note sets "pondré mi ley ... la escribiré en su corazón" for 31:33, the key words of Hebrews 8:10; Readable keeps "enseñanza".

decisions.choice: sheria
decisions.reason: *Torah* is "sheria" at Literal and Balanced here, as Hebrews 8:10 has it and the terms note sets for this verse; Readable keeps the usual "mafundisho" (teaching).

decisions.choice: "ma loi" (L); "mon instruction" (B); "mon enseignement" (R)
decisions.reason: God's torah as the terms note sets it. Hebrews 8:10 has "mes lois" from the Greek; this verse keeps the Hebrew singular, with Hebrews' other key words ("je serai leur Dieu, et ils seront mon peuple").

decisions.choice: "Ta sẽ là Đức Chúa Trời của họ, và họ sẽ là dân của Ta"; "luật pháp" (L, B), "lời dạy" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note keeps Hebrews 8:10's terms for the covenant formula and for "law" (torah) at Literal and Balanced; Readable says "lời dạy", as the English says "teaching".

decisions.choice: "가르침" for *torah*
decisions.reason: As the terms note and the English "instruction": God's teaching (meaning decision m1). Hebrews 8:10 has "율법", following the Greek *nomos*; the difference is in the source text, not in the sense.

decisions.choice: "마음에 기록하다" (L); "마음에 새기다" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's verbs for writing on the heart; "새기다" says that it is written to stay.

decisions.choice: a minha instrução (L, B); o meu ensino (R)
decisions.reason: The rest of the verse keeps Hebrews 8:10's Portuguese at each level ("Pois esta [é] a aliança que firmarei ... depois daqueles dias"; "quando aqueles dias tiverem passado"). Two things differ. The gift: Hebrews' Greek has "my laws", plural, in the mind and on the hearts, while the Hebrew has the one word torah, God's teaching (m1), put "within them" and written "on their heart". Torah is "a instrução" (L, B) and "o ensino" (R), as Isaiah 2:3 sets it; the pronoun "a" / "-lo" refers back to it. And the covenant promise keeps the words 7:23 sets for the book at every level, "serei o Deus deles, e eles serão o meu povo": Hebrews' Literal "serei para eles como Deus" follows the Greek "eis theon" and could be read as "like God", which the Hebrew does not say.

source.text: וְלֹ֧א יְלַמְּד֣וּ ע֗וֹד אִ֣ישׁ אֶת־רֵעֵ֜הוּ וְאִ֤ישׁ אֶת־אָחִיו֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר דְּע֖וּ אֶת־יְהוָ֑ה כִּֽי־כוּלָּם֩ יֵדְע֨וּ אוֹתִ֜י לְמִקְטַנָּ֤ם וְעַד־גְּדוֹלָם֙ נְאֻם־יְהוָ֔ה כִּ֤י אֶסְלַח֙ לַֽעֲוֺנָ֔ם וּלְחַטָּאתָ֖ם לֹ֥א אֶזְכָּר־עֽוֹד׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And they will not teach again, each his neighbor and each his brother, saying, Know Yahweh; for they all will know me, from their least and to their greatest, declares Yahweh; for I will forgive their iniquity, and their sin I will not remember again.

en.L: And they will no longer teach, each {{gender:their|his}} neighbor and each {{gender:their|his}} {{gender:brother or sister|brother}}, saying, "Know {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}," for they will all know {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, from the least of them to the greatest of them, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; for I will forgive their iniquity, and their sin I will remember no more.
en.B: No longer will each one teach {{gender:their|his}} neighbor, or each one {{gender:their|his}} {{gender:brother or sister|brother}}, saying, "Know {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}," because all of them will know {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, from the least to the greatest, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. For I will forgive their guilt, and I will remember their sin no more.
en.R: They will not need to teach their neighbors or their relatives to know {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, because all of them will know {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, from the least important to the most important, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. I will forgive their sins and never again remember the wrong they have done.

es.L: Y no enseñarán más cada uno a su prójimo, y cada uno a {{gender:su hermano o hermana|su hermano}}, diciendo: «Conoce {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}», porque todos ellos {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} conocerán, desde el más pequeño de ellos hasta el más grande de ellos, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}; porque perdonaré su iniquidad, y nunca más me acordaré de su pecado.
es.B: Ya no tendrá cada uno que enseñar a su prójimo, ni cada uno a {{gender:su hermano o hermana|su hermano}}, diciendo: «Conoce {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}», porque todos {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} conocerán, desde el más pequeño hasta el más grande, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Porque perdonaré su culpa, y nunca más me acordaré de su pecado.
es.R: Ya no tendrán que enseñar a sus vecinos ni a sus parientes a conocer {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, porque todos {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} conocerán, desde el menos importante hasta el más importante, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Perdonaré sus pecados y nunca más me acordaré del mal que han hecho.

fr.L: Et ils n’enseigneront plus, chacun son prochain et chacun {{gender:son frère ou sa sœur|son frère}}, en disant : « Connaissez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} », car ils {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} connaîtront tous, du plus petit d’entre eux jusqu’au plus grand d’entre eux, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; car je pardonnerai leur iniquité, et de leur péché je ne {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} souviendrai plus.
fr.B: Personne n’enseignera plus son prochain ni {{gender:son frère ou sa sœur|son frère}} en disant : « Connaissez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} », car tous {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} connaîtront, du plus petit jusqu’au plus grand, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Car je pardonnerai leur faute, et je ne {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} souviendrai plus de leur péché.
fr.R: Ils n’auront plus besoin d’apprendre à leurs voisins ou à leur famille à connaître {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, car tous {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} connaîtront, du plus petit jusqu’au plus grand, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Je pardonnerai leurs péchés et je ne {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} souviendrai plus jamais du mal qu’ils ont fait.

sw.L: Wala hawatafundisha tena, kila mmoja jirani yake na kila mmoja ndugu yake, wakisema, "Mjue {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}," kwa maana wote watanijua {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}, tangu aliye mdogo wao hadi aliye mkubwa wao, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; kwa maana nitausamehe uovu wao, na dhambi yao sitaikumbuka tena.
sw.B: Hakuna tena atakayemfundisha jirani yake, wala ndugu yake, akisema, "Mjue {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}," kwa sababu wote watanijua {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}, tangu aliye mdogo hadi aliye mkubwa, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Kwa maana nitaisamehe hatia yao, wala sitaikumbuka tena dhambi yao.
sw.R: Hawatahitaji kuwafundisha jirani zao wala jamaa zao kumjua {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa sababu wote watanijua {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}, tangu asiye na cheo hadi aliye na cheo kikubwa, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Nitawasamehe dhambi zao, wala sitakumbuka tena kamwe mabaya waliyotenda.

vi.L: Họ sẽ không còn dạy nhau, mỗi người dạy người lân cận mình và mỗi người dạy anh em mình rằng: "Hãy nhận biết {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}," vì hết thảy họ sẽ biết Ta, từ người nhỏ nhất đến người lớn nhất trong họ, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy; vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ tha thứ tội ác họ, và tội lỗi họ {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không nhớ đến nữa.
vi.B: Sẽ không còn ai phải dạy người lân cận mình hay dạy anh chị em mình rằng: "Hãy nhận biết {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}," vì hết thảy họ sẽ biết Ta, từ người nhỏ nhất đến người lớn nhất, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy. Vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ tha thứ tội ác họ, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ không bao giờ nhớ đến tội lỗi họ nữa.
vi.R: Họ sẽ không cần dạy người hàng xóm hay người bà con mình nhận biết {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì hết thảy họ sẽ biết Ta, từ người hèn mọn nhất đến người quan trọng nhất, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán. Ta sẽ tha thứ tội lỗi họ và không bao giờ nhớ đến những điều sai trái họ đã làm nữa.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 다시는 각자 자기 이웃과 각자 자기 {{gender:형제자매|형제}}에게 "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 알아라." 하고 가르치지 않을 것이다. 그들 가운데 작은 사람부터 큰 사람까지 모두 나를 알 것이기 때문이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다. 내가 그들의 죄악을 용서하고, 그들의 죄를 다시는 기억하지 않을 것이기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그들은 더 이상 저마다 이웃이나 {{gender:형제자매|형제}}에게 "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 알아라." 하고 가르치지 않을 것이다. 작은 사람부터 큰 사람까지 그들이 모두 나를 알 것이기 때문이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 내가 그들의 허물을 용서하고, 그들의 죄를 다시는 기억하지 않을 것이다.
ko.R: 그들은 이웃이나 친척에게 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 알라고 가르칠 필요가 없을 것이다. 가장 보잘것없는 사람부터 가장 높은 사람까지 그들이 모두 나를 알 것이기 때문이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 내가 그들의 죄를 용서하고, 그들이 저지른 잘못을 다시는 기억하지 않을 것이다.

pt.L: E não ensinarão mais, cada um o seu próximo e cada um {{gender:o seu irmão ou a sua irmã|o seu irmão}}, dizendo: "Conheça {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}", porque todos eles {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} conhecerão, desde o menor deles até o maior deles, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}; pois perdoarei a iniquidade deles, e do pecado deles não {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} lembrarei mais.
pt.B: Nenhum deles precisará ensinar o seu próximo ou {{gender:o seu irmão ou irmã|o seu irmão}}, dizendo: "Conheça {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}", porque todos {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} conhecerão, do menor ao maior, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}. Pois perdoarei a culpa deles, e do seu pecado nunca mais {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} lembrarei.
pt.R: Ninguém vai precisar ensinar o vizinho ou o parente a conhecer {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, pois todos vão {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} conhecer, do mais humilde ao mais importante, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}. Vou perdoar os pecados deles e nunca mais vou {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} lembrar do mal que eles fizeram.

decisions.choice: know the LORD: know God personally, in a living relationship of trust and obedience
decisions.reason: To know God is more than knowing about him; it means doing justice and living close to him (9:23; 22:15-16; Hosea 6:6). In the new covenant every member of the people will know God, not only priests and prophets.

decisions.choice: from the least to the greatest: everyone, whatever their age or rank
decisions.reason: The phrase means all without exception (6:13; 42:1).

decisions.choice: for I will forgive: forgiveness is the ground of the new covenant
decisions.reason: The "for" gives the reason: all will know God because he forgives. "Remember no more" means that God will no longer hold the sin against them; it does not mean that he forgets (compare Isaiah 43:25).

decisions.choice: used in the New Testament: Hebrews 8:11-12; 10:17
decisions.reason: Hebrews quotes the promise of forgiveness to show that no further offering for sin is needed (Hebrews 10:17-18).

decisions.choice: their neighbor, their brother or sister (with his neighbor, his brother as the alternatives)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "each his neighbor and each his brother" means everyone in the community, women and men. Readable says "relatives" for the family word, which needs no span.

decisions.choice: iniquity, sin (Literal); guilt, sin (Balanced); sins, the wrong they have done (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in Isaiah, Balanced says "guilt" and Readable "sins" for the first word; Readable gives the second as "the wrong they have done".

decisions.choice: They will not need to teach
decisions.reason: Readable adds "need" to show that the teaching stops because it is no longer necessary.

decisions.choice: {{gender:su hermano o hermana|su hermano}}
decisions.reason: Singular "hermano" names a man, so Spanish has two real wordings here, as the English has; the inclusive one is the default.

decisions.choice: nunca más me acordaré de su pecado
decisions.reason: The wording the terms note sets for 31:34, keeping the key term of Hebrews 8:12 ("nunca más ... sus pecados") so the reader can see the quotation.

decisions.choice: jirani yake, ndugu yake
decisions.reason: "Ndugu" covers brother and sister, so Swahili has no gender alternative here, as in Hebrews 8:11.

decisions.choice: "son frère ou sa sœur", with "son frère" as the gender alternative; "chacun son prochain" with no span
decisions.reason: As Hebrews 8:11 in French, which has the same span; "chacun ... son" is generic French and needs none.

decisions.choice: "du plus petit jusqu'au plus grand"
decisions.reason: The key words of Hebrews 8:11 in French, as the terms note sets.

decisions.choice: "Hãy nhận biết CHÚA"; "anh em" (L), "anh chị em" (B), "người bà con" (R)
decisions.reason: The key words follow the published Hebrews 8:11-12. Balanced says "anh chị em" outright, since the meaning includes sisters; Literal keeps the Hebrew "anh em", and no setting span is needed.

decisions.choice: "{{gender:형제자매|형제}}"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "brother" means a fellow Israelite; Korean uses the style guide's span, with "형제" as the alternative, as the English does and as Hebrews 8:11 is published. Readable says "친척", which needs no alternative.

decisions.choice: "작은 사람부터 큰 사람까지"; "다시는 기억하지 않을 것이다"
decisions.reason: The terms note's key phrases, kept so the reader sees Hebrews 8:11-12 (meaning decision m4).

decisions.choice: Hebrews 8:11-12's Portuguese kept: "Conheça ...", "porque todos me conhecerão, do menor ao maior", "Nenhum deles precisará ensinar", "nunca mais me lembrarei"
alternatives: serei misericordioso para com as injustiças deles
decisions.reason: The verse keeps the words of Hebrews 8:11-12 and 10:17 in Portuguese at each level where the Hebrew allows (m4). The differences: the Hebrew re'a is "o seu próximo" (L, B), where Hebrews' Greek has "fellow citizen", "concidadão"; the Hebrew says "perdoarei" (forgive), where the Greek has "I will be merciful"; Jeremiah has "declara o SENHOR" in the middle of the verse; and the sin is singular at Literal and Balanced, as in the Hebrew. The iniquity is "iniquidade" (L), "culpa" (B), as in verse 30.

decisions.choice: {{gender:o seu irmão ou a sua irmã|o seu irmão}}; "o seu próximo" with no setting
decisions.reason: Portuguese "seu" and "próximo" already cover men and women, so only "irmão" needs the setting, with the forms Hebrews 8:11 uses; Readable says "o parente", as the English Readable says "relatives".

source.text: כֹּ֣ה׀אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה נֹתֵ֥ן שֶׁ֨מֶשׁ֙ לְא֣וֹר יוֹמָ֔ם חֻקֹּ֛ת יָרֵ֥חַ וְכוֹכָבִ֖ים לְא֣וֹר לָ֑יְלָה רֹגַ֤ע הַיָּם֙ וַיֶּהֱמ֣וּ גַלָּ֔יו יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁמֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Thus says Yahweh, [who] gives [the] sun for light by day, [the] fixed orders of [the] moon and stars for light [by] night, [who] stirs up the sea, and its waves roar, Yahweh of hosts [is] his name:

en.L: Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, who gives the sun for light by day, the fixed orders of the moon and the stars for light by night, who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar; {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of hosts [is] {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name:
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} says this, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} who gives the sun to light the day and the moon and stars in their fixed order to light the night, who stirs up the sea until its waves roar; {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies is {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name:
en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says. He gives the sun to shine during the day. He set the moon and stars in their order to shine at night. He stirs up the sea and makes its waves roar. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} of Armies is {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name. He says:

es.L: Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, que da el sol para luz del día, las leyes fijas de la luna y de las estrellas para luz de la noche, que agita el mar y bramen sus olas; {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los ejércitos [es] {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre:
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto, {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} que da el sol para alumbrar el día, y la luna y las estrellas en su orden fijo para alumbrar la noche, que agita el mar hasta que rugen sus olas; {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos es {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre:
es.R: Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Él da el sol para que brille de día. Puso la luna y las estrellas en su orden para que brillen de noche. Agita el mar y hace rugir sus olas. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} de los Ejércitos es {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre. Él dice:

fr.L: Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, qui donne le soleil pour éclairer le jour, les lois de la lune et des étoiles pour éclairer la nuit, qui agite la mer et ses flots mugissent ; {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées [est] {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom :
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} qui donne le soleil pour éclairer le jour et la lune et les étoiles dans leur ordre fixé pour éclairer la nuit, qui soulève la mer jusqu’à faire mugir ses flots ; {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées est {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom :
fr.R: Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. C’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui donne le soleil pour briller pendant le jour. Il a placé la lune et les étoiles dans leur ordre pour briller la nuit. Il agite la mer et fait mugir ses vagues. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} des armées, c’est {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom. Il dit :

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi, yeye atoaye jua liwe nuru wakati wa mchana, na amri za mwezi na nyota ziwe nuru wakati wa usiku, auchafuaye bahari hata mawimbi yake yakavuma; {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi [ndilo] jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}:
sw.B: Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atoaye jua liangaze mchana, na mwezi na nyota kwa mpangilio wake maalum ziangaze usiku, aichafuaye bahari hata mawimbi yake yakanguruma; {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi ndilo jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}:
sw.R: Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema. Yeye hulitoa jua liangaze wakati wa mchana. Aliuweka mwezi na nyota kwa mpangilio wake ziangaze usiku. Huichafua bahari na kuyafanya mawimbi yake yangurume. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wa majeshi ndilo jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}. Anasema:

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này, là Đấng ban mặt trời làm ánh sáng ban ngày, ban những luật định của mặt trăng và các ngôi sao làm ánh sáng ban đêm, Đấng khuấy động biển để sóng gầm thét; danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân:
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là Đấng ban mặt trời để soi sáng ban ngày, ban mặt trăng và các ngôi sao theo trật tự cố định để soi sáng ban đêm, Đấng khuấy động biển cho đến khi sóng gầm thét; danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân:
vi.R: Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán. Ngài ban mặt trời để chiếu sáng ban ngày. Ngài đặt mặt trăng và các ngôi sao theo thứ tự để chiếu sáng ban đêm. Ngài khuấy động biển và làm cho sóng gầm thét. Danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Vạn Quân. Ngài phán:

ko.L: 낮에는 해를 빛으로 주시고, 밤에는 달과 별들의 규례를 빛으로 주시며, 바다를 뒤흔들어 그 물결이 소리치게 하시는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}, 그 이름이 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이신 분께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 해를 주셔서 낮을 밝히시고, 달과 별들이 질서를 따라 밤을 밝히게 하시며, 바다를 뒤흔들어 물결이 소리치게 하신다. 그분의 이름은 만군의 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이시다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 그분은 해를 주셔서 낮에 빛나게 하신다. 달과 별들이 순서대로 밤에 빛나게 하신다. 바다를 뒤흔들어 파도가 소리치게 하신다. 그분의 이름은 하늘의 군대를 거느리신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이시다. 그분께서 말씀하신다.

pt.L: Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, que dá o sol para luz de dia, as leis fixas da lua e das estrelas para luz de noite, que agita o mar de modo que as suas ondas rugem; {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos [é] o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome:
pt.B: Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} que dá o sol para iluminar o dia, e a lua e as estrelas na sua ordem fixa para iluminar a noite, que agita o mar até as suas ondas rugirem; {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos é o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome:
pt.R: É isto que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} diz. Ele dá o sol para brilhar durante o dia. Ele pôs a lua e as estrelas na sua ordem para brilhar à noite. Ele agita o mar e faz as suas ondas rugirem. {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} dos Exércitos é o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome. Ele diz:

decisions.choice: the fixed orders: the laws God set for the moon and stars
decisions.reason: The word means decrees or statutes. Here it is the order God gave to the heavens, so that they keep their courses (Genesis 1:14-18; 8:22; Job 38:33). The same word is used in verse 36 and in 33:25.

decisions.choice: stirs up the sea: churns the sea into a storm
decisions.reason: The verb can mean to stir up or to calm, but the roaring waves favor "stir up". Isaiah 51:15 has the same line.

decisions.choice: the same words as Isaiah 51:15
decisions.reason: "Who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar; the LORD of hosts is his name" is word for word the line of Isaiah 51:15, and the wording here follows it.

decisions.choice: He gives ... He set ... He stirs up ... He says:
decisions.reason: Readable turns the descriptions of God into short sentences and adds "He says" before the promise of verse 36.

decisions.choice: The descriptions placed before "{{divine_name:주|야훼}} ... 말씀하신다"
decisions.reason: Korean puts descriptive clauses before the noun they describe, so Literal gathers them into one sentence ending in the formula; Balanced and Readable state the formula first and then describe God in sentences, as the English does.

decisions.choice: que agita o mar de modo que as suas ondas rugem (L); até as suas ondas rugirem (B)
decisions.reason: The line is word for word Isaiah 51:15 (m3), so it keeps that verse's Portuguese at each level.

source.text: אִם־יָמֻ֜שׁוּ הַחֻקִּ֥ים הָאֵ֛לֶּה מִלְּפָנַ֖י נְאֻם־יְהוָ֑ה גַּם֩ זֶ֨רַע יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל יִשְׁבְּת֗וּ מִֽהְי֥וֹת גּ֛וֹי לְפָנַ֖י כָּל־הַיָּמִֽים׃ס

records.literal_gloss: If these fixed orders depart from before me, declares Yahweh, also [the] offspring of Israel will cease from being a nation before me all the days.

en.L: If these fixed orders depart from before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, then the offspring of Israel also will cease from being a nation before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} for all time.
en.B: Only if this fixed order ever failed before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, would the descendants of Israel ever cease to be a nation before {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}.
en.R: Only if these laws that keep the sun, moon and stars in place stopped working, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, would the people of Israel ever stop being a nation in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} sight.

es.L: Si estas leyes fijas se apartan de delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, también la descendencia de Israel dejará de ser nación delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} para siempre.
es.B: Solo si ese orden fijo fallara alguna vez delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, dejarían los descendientes de Israel de ser una nación delante de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}.
es.R: Solo si dejaran de funcionar las leyes que mantienen en su lugar al sol, la luna y las estrellas, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, dejaría el pueblo de Israel de ser una nación ante {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} ojos.

fr.L: Si ces lois s’écartent de devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, alors la descendance d’Israël aussi cessera d’être une nation devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} pour toujours.
fr.B: C’est seulement si cet ordre fixé venait à faillir devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, que la descendance d’Israël cesserait d’être une nation devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}.
fr.R: C’est seulement si les lois qui maintiennent le soleil, la lune et les étoiles à leur place cessaient de fonctionner, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, que le peuple d’Israël cesserait d’être une nation devant {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}.

sw.L: Kama amri hizi zikiondoka mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ndipo uzao wa Israeli nao utakoma kuwa taifa mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} siku zote.
sw.B: Ikiwa tu mpangilio huu ungewahi kushindwa mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ndipo wazao wa Israeli wangeacha kuwa taifa mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}.
sw.R: Ikiwa tu sheria hizi zinazoshikilia jua, mwezi na nyota mahali pake zingeacha kufanya kazi, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ndipo watu wa Israeli wangeacha kuwa taifa mbele {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}.

vi.L: Nếu những luật định này biến mất khỏi trước mặt Ta, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, thì dòng dõi Y-sơ-ra-ên cũng sẽ thôi làm một dân tộc trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mãi mãi.
vi.B: Chỉ khi nào trật tự cố định ấy không còn trước mặt Ta, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, thì dòng dõi Y-sơ-ra-ên mới thôi làm một dân tộc trước mặt Ta.
vi.R: Chỉ khi nào những luật giữ mặt trời, mặt trăng và các ngôi sao ở đúng chỗ ngừng hoạt động, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán, thì dân Y-sơ-ra-ên mới thôi làm một dân tộc trước mặt Ta.

ko.L: 이 규례들이 내 앞에서 사라진다면, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다, 이스라엘 자손도 내 앞에서 영원히 한 민족이 되기를 그칠 것이다.
ko.B: 이 질서가 내 앞에서 무너지는 일이 있다면, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다, 그때에야 이스라엘 자손이 내 앞에서 한 민족으로 있기를 그칠 것이다.
ko.R: 해와 달과 별들을 제자리에 있게 하는 이 법칙들이 무너진다면, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다, 그때에야 이스라엘 백성이 내 앞에서 한 민족으로 있기를 그칠 것이다.

pt.L: Se estas leis fixas se afastarem de diante de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, então também a descendência de Israel deixará de ser uma nação diante de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}} para sempre.
pt.B: Só se esta ordem fixa falhasse diante de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, é que os descendentes de Israel deixariam de ser uma nação diante de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}.
pt.R: Só se essas leis que mantêm o sol, a lua e as estrelas no lugar parassem de funcionar, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, é que o povo de Israel deixaria de ser uma nação diante de {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}.

decisions.choice: if ... then also: an impossible condition that makes the promise certain
decisions.reason: The order of the heavens will not fail, so Israel will not cease to be God's nation. The same kind of oath appears in 33:20-21, 25-26.

decisions.choice: the offspring of Israel: the descendants of Israel, the people
decisions.reason: The word is "seed", meaning descendants (verse 27 uses it of new life sown in the land).

decisions.choice: all the days: for all time
decisions.reason: The phrase means always, forever.

decisions.choice: Only if ... would ...
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable put the impossible condition so that the certainty of the promise is clear.

decisions.choice: these laws that keep the sun, moon and stars in place
decisions.reason: Readable says what the fixed orders of verse 35 are.

decisions.choice: The formula set off by commas inside the conditional sentence
decisions.reason: The Hebrew places "declares the LORD" inside the condition; Korean can keep it there only between commas, which all three levels do.

source.text: כֹּ֣ה׀אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה אִם־יִמַּ֤דּוּ שָׁמַ֨יִם֙ מִלְמַ֔עְלָה וְיֵחָקְר֥וּ מֽוֹסְדֵי־אֶ֖רֶץ לְמָ֑טָּה גַּם־אֲנִ֞י אֶמְאַ֨ס בְּכָל־זֶ֧רַע יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל עַֽל־כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשׂ֖וּ נְאֻם־יְהוָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: Thus says Yahweh: If [the] heavens above can be measured, and [the] foundations of [the] earth below be searched out, also I will reject all [the] offspring of Israel for all that they have done, declares Yahweh.

en.L: Thus says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: If the heavens above can be measured, and the foundations of the earth below searched out, then I also will reject all the offspring of Israel for all that they have done, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} says this: Only if someone could measure the heavens above and search out the foundations of the earth below would I reject all the descendants of Israel because of all they have done, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: This is what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} says: No one can measure the sky above or explore the deep foundations of the earth. Only if someone could do that would I reject the people of Israel, even for all they have done, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Así dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: Si los cielos arriba pueden ser medidos, y explorados abajo los cimientos de la tierra, también yo desecharé a toda la descendencia de Israel por todo lo que han hecho, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dice esto: Solo si alguien pudiera medir los cielos arriba y explorar los cimientos de la tierra abajo, desecharía yo a todos los descendientes de Israel por todo lo que han hecho, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Esto es lo que dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}: Nadie puede medir el cielo ni explorar los cimientos profundos de la tierra. Solo si alguien pudiera hacerlo, rechazaría yo al pueblo de Israel, aun por todo lo que ha hecho, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Ainsi parle {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : Si les cieux en haut peuvent être mesurés, et les fondements de la terre en bas sondés, alors {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} aussi je rejetterai toute la descendance d’Israël pour tout ce qu’ils ont fait, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dit ceci : C’est seulement si l’on pouvait mesurer les cieux en haut et sonder les fondements de la terre en bas que je rejetterais toute la descendance d’Israël à cause de tout ce qu’ils ont fait, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Voici ce que dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} : Personne ne peut mesurer le ciel là-haut ni explorer les fondations profondes de la terre. C’est seulement si quelqu’un pouvait le faire que je rejetterais le peuple d’Israël, même pour tout ce qu’il a fait, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asema hivi: Kama mbingu zilizo juu zinaweza kupimwa, na misingi ya dunia iliyo chini kuchunguzwa, ndipo {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} nami nitaukataa uzao wote wa Israeli kwa ajili ya yote waliyoyatenda, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Hivi ndivyo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} asemavyo: Ikiwa tu mtu angeweza kuzipima mbingu zilizo juu na kuichunguza misingi ya dunia iliyo chini, ndipo ningewakataa wazao wote wa Israeli kwa sababu ya yote waliyoyatenda, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Hili ndilo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} analosema: Hakuna mtu anayeweza kupima anga lililo juu wala kuchunguza misingi ya dunia iliyo chini kabisa. Ikiwa tu mtu angeweza kufanya hivyo, ndipo ningewakataa watu wa Israeli, hata kwa yote waliyoyatenda, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này: Nếu các tầng trời trên cao có thể đo được, và các nền móng của đất bên dưới có thể dò thấu, thì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} cũng sẽ loại bỏ cả dòng dõi Y-sơ-ra-ên vì mọi điều chúng đã làm, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy: Chỉ khi nào người ta có thể đo được các tầng trời trên cao và dò thấu nền móng của đất bên dưới, thì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mới loại bỏ cả dòng dõi Y-sơ-ra-ên vì mọi điều chúng đã làm, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy.
vi.R: Đây là lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán: Không ai có thể đo được bầu trời trên cao hay dò thấu nền móng sâu thẳm của đất. Chỉ khi nào có người làm được điều ấy, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mới loại bỏ dân Y-sơ-ra-ên, dù chúng đã làm biết bao điều sai trái, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 위로 하늘을 잴 수 있고 아래로 땅의 기초를 살필 수 있다면, 나도 이스라엘의 모든 자손을 그들이 행한 모든 일 때문에 버리겠다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이렇게 말씀하신다. 누가 위로 하늘을 재고 아래로 땅의 기초를 샅샅이 살필 수 있다면, 그때에야 내가 이스라엘의 모든 자손을 그들이 저지른 모든 일 때문에 버릴 것이다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 하시는 말씀이다. 아무도 위로 하늘을 재거나 아래로 땅의 깊은 기초를 살필 수 없다. 누가 그렇게 할 수 있다면, 그때에야 내가 이스라엘 백성을 버릴 것이다. 그들이 그 모든 일을 저질렀어도 그렇다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다.

pt.L: Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: Se os céus em cima puderem ser medidos, e os fundamentos da terra embaixo puderem ser sondados, então também eu rejeitarei toda a descendência de Israel por tudo o que fizeram, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.B: Assim diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}: Só se alguém pudesse medir os céus lá em cima e sondar os fundamentos da terra cá embaixo é que eu rejeitaria todos os descendentes de Israel por tudo o que fizeram, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.R: É isto que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} diz: Ninguém consegue medir o céu lá em cima nem explorar os fundamentos profundos da terra. Só se alguém conseguisse fazer isso é que eu rejeitaria o povo de Israel, mesmo por tudo o que eles fizeram, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.

decisions.choice: if the heavens can be measured ... then I will reject: a second impossible condition
decisions.reason: No one can measure the heavens or search out the earth's foundations (Job 38:4-6; Isaiah 40:12). So God will never reject Israel as a whole.

decisions.choice: for all that they have done: God admits the people's sins would deserve rejection
decisions.reason: God does not deny that Israel's sins are great. The promise rests on his faithfulness, not on their deserving it.

decisions.choice: No one can measure ... Only if someone could do that
decisions.reason: Readable first states that the condition is impossible, then gives the promise.

source.text: הִנֵּ֛ה יָמִ֥ים בָּאִ֖יםנְאֻם־יְהוָ֑ה וְנִבְנְתָ֤ה הָעִיר֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה מִמִּגְדַּ֥ל חֲנַנְאֵ֖ל שַׁ֥עַר הַפִּנָּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, days [are coming], declares Yahweh, when the city will be rebuilt for Yahweh from [the] Tower of Hananel [to the] Gate of the Corner.

en.L: Look, days [are] coming, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, when the city will be rebuilt for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} from the Tower of Hananel [to] the Corner Gate.
en.B: The days are coming, declares {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, when the city will be rebuilt for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} from the Tower of Hananel to the Corner Gate.
en.R: A time is coming, says {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, when Jerusalem will be rebuilt for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. It will reach from the Tower of Hananel to the Corner Gate.

es.L: He aquí vienen días, declara {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, en que la ciudad será reedificada para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} desde la torre de Hananel [hasta] la puerta del Ángulo.
es.B: Vienen días, afirma {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, en que la ciudad será reedificada para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} desde la torre de Hananel hasta la puerta del Ángulo.
es.R: Se acerca el tiempo, dice {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, en que Jerusalén será reconstruida para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Se extenderá desde la torre de Hananel hasta la puerta del Ángulo.

fr.L: Voici, des jours [viennent], déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, où la ville sera rebâtie pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} depuis la tour de Hananéel [jusqu’à] la porte de l’Angle.
fr.B: Des jours viennent, déclare {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, où la ville sera rebâtie pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, de la tour de Hananéel à la porte de l’Angle.
fr.R: Un temps vient, dit {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, où Jérusalem sera reconstruite pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Elle s’étendra de la tour de Hananéel jusqu’à la porte de l’Angle.

sw.L: Tazama, siku [zinakuja], asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, mji utakapojengwa tena kwa ajili ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kutoka Mnara wa Hananeli [mpaka] Lango la Pembeni.
sw.B: Siku zinakuja, asema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ambapo mji utajengwa tena kwa ajili ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kutoka Mnara wa Hananeli mpaka Lango la Pembeni.
sw.R: Wakati unakuja, anasema {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ambapo Yerusalemu utajengwa tena kwa ajili ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Utaenea kutoka Mnara wa Hananeli mpaka Lango la Pembeni.

vi.L: Kìa, những ngày [đang đến], {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, khi thành sẽ được xây lại cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, từ tháp Ha-na-nên [đến] Cổng Góc.
vi.B: Sẽ đến những ngày, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán vậy, thành sẽ được xây lại cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, từ tháp Ha-na-nên đến Cổng Góc.
vi.R: Sẽ đến lúc, {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán, Giê-ru-sa-lem sẽ được xây lại cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Thành sẽ trải dài từ tháp Ha-na-nên đến Cổng Góc.

ko.L: 보아라, 날들이 [온다]. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 선언이다. 그때에 그 성이 하나넬 망대에서 모퉁이 문까지 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 위하여 다시 세워질 것이다.
ko.B: 때가 오고 있다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 그때에 그 성이 하나넬 망대에서 모퉁이 문까지 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 위하여 다시 세워질 것이다.
ko.R: 때가 오고 있다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}가 말한다. 그때에 예루살렘이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 위하여 다시 세워질 것이다. 그 성은 하나넬 망대에서 모퉁이 문까지 이를 것이다.

pt.L: Eis que [vêm] dias, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, em que a cidade será reconstruída para {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, desde a Torre de Hananel [até] a Porta da Esquina.
