pt.B: Vêm dias, declara {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, em que a cidade será reconstruída para {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, desde a Torre de Hananel até a Porta da Esquina.
pt.R: Está chegando o tempo, diz {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, em que Jerusalém vai ser reconstruída para {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}. Ela vai se estender da Torre de Hananel até a Porta da Esquina.

decisions.choice: are coming: the word read aloud but not written in the Hebrew text
alternatives: Look, days, declares the LORD (written text)
decisions.reason: The written Hebrew has "Look, days, declares the LORD"; the scribes' marginal note (qere) supplies "are coming", as in verses 27 and 31. The translation follows the marginal reading.

decisions.choice: the Tower of Hananel and the Corner Gate: points on the north wall of Jerusalem
decisions.reason: The Tower of Hananel stood at the north-east corner of the city near the Sheep Gate (Nehemiah 3:1; 12:39); the Corner Gate was at the north-west (2 Kings 14:13; Zechariah 14:10). Their exact places are uncertain. The line runs along the whole north side.

decisions.choice: rebuilt for the LORD: a city belonging to God
decisions.reason: The city will be built as God's own, and verse 40 calls it holy to the LORD.

decisions.choice: Jerusalem ... It will reach
decisions.reason: Readable names the city and says that the two places mark its extent.

decisions.choice: "tháp Ha-na-nên"; "Cổng Góc"
decisions.reason: "Cổng Góc" is the published name (2 Chronicles 26:9); "Ha-na-nên" is new.

decisions.choice: "하나넬 망대"; "모퉁이 문"
decisions.reason: The usual Korean forms of these landmarks (2 Kings 14:13 for the Corner Gate).

decisions.choice: "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 위하여", in God's own mouth with the plain particle
decisions.reason: God speaks of the city rebuilt for himself in the third person; Korean keeps the plain particle, as God does not honor himself.

decisions.choice: a Torre de Hananel; a Porta da Esquina
decisions.reason: The two landmarks (m2) take the forms Nehemiah 3:1 and 2 Kings 14:13 give them in Portuguese, with capitals as names.

source.text: וְיָצָ֨א ע֜וֹד קָ֤ו הַמִּדָּה֙ נֶגְדּ֔וֹ עַ֖ל גִּבְעַ֣ת גָּרֵ֑ב וְנָסַ֖ב גֹּעָֽתָה׃

records.literal_gloss: And will go out again [the] measuring line straight ahead over [the] hill of Gareb, and it will turn [to] Goah.

en.L: And the measuring line will go out again, straight ahead to the hill of Gareb, and it will turn to Goah.
en.B: The measuring line will stretch out farther, straight to the hill of Gareb, and then turn toward Goah.
en.R: The measuring line will go on from there straight to the hill of Gareb and then turn toward Goah.

es.L: Y saldrá otra vez el cordel de medir derecho hasta la colina de Gareb, y dará la vuelta hacia Goa.
es.B: El cordel de medir se extenderá más allá, derecho hasta la colina de Gareb, y luego girará hacia Goa.
es.R: El cordel de medir seguirá desde allí derecho hasta la colina de Gareb y luego girará hacia Goa.

fr.L: Et le cordeau à mesurer sortira encore, droit devant, jusqu’à la colline de Gareb, et il tournera vers Goa.
fr.B: Le cordeau à mesurer s’étendra plus loin, tout droit jusqu’à la colline de Gareb, puis il tournera vers Goa.
fr.R: Le cordeau à mesurer ira de là tout droit jusqu’à la colline de Gareb, puis il tournera vers Goa.

sw.L: Na kamba ya kupimia itatoka tena moja kwa moja mpaka kilima cha Garebu, nayo itageuka [kwenda] Goa.
sw.B: Kamba ya kupimia itanyooshwa mbele zaidi, moja kwa moja mpaka kilima cha Garebu, kisha igeuke kuelekea Goa.
sw.R: Kamba ya kupimia itaendelea kutoka hapo moja kwa moja mpaka kilima cha Garebu, kisha igeuke kuelekea Goa.

vi.L: Dây đo sẽ giăng ra thêm nữa, thẳng đến đồi Ga-rép, rồi quay về Gô-a.
vi.B: Dây đo sẽ giăng xa hơn nữa, thẳng đến đồi Ga-rép, rồi rẽ về phía Gô-a.
vi.R: Dây đo sẽ giăng tiếp từ đó thẳng đến đồi Ga-rép, rồi rẽ về phía Gô-a.

ko.L: 그리고 측량줄이 다시 곧게 뻗어 가렙 언덕까지 나아가고, 고아로 돌아갈 것이다.
ko.B: 측량줄이 더 멀리 가렙 언덕까지 곧게 뻗어 나가서, 고아 쪽으로 돌아갈 것이다.
ko.R: 측량줄이 거기에서 가렙 언덕까지 곧게 뻗어 나간 다음, 고아 쪽으로 돌아갈 것이다.

pt.L: E o cordel de medir sairá ainda adiante, em linha reta até a colina de Garebe, e virará para Goa.
pt.B: O cordel de medir se estenderá mais adiante, direto até a colina de Garebe, e depois virará para Goa.
pt.R: O cordel de medir vai seguir dali em linha reta até a colina de Garebe e depois vai virar na direção de Goa.

decisions.choice: the measuring line: the reading the scribes marked to be read aloud
decisions.reason: The written Hebrew has a slightly different spelling of the word for line; the marginal note (qere) gives the usual form. The meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: Gareb and Goah: places on the west or south of the city, otherwise unknown
decisions.reason: These names occur nowhere else in Scripture, and where they were is not known. The line of verses 38-40 seems to run around the city from the north, west and south to the Kidron in the east.

decisions.choice: the measuring line: a cord used to mark out a building plot
decisions.reason: Builders and surveyors marked out land with a line (Zechariah 2:5-6; Ezekiel 40:3). Here it marks out the new city, larger than before.

decisions.choice: o cordel de medir; Garebe; Goa
decisions.reason: The surveyor's cord (m3) is "o cordel de medir", the Portuguese for a builder's line. The two unknown places (m2) take Portuguese spellings of their sounds, "Garebe" with the final vowel Portuguese adds, as in "Calebe".

source.text: וְכָל־הָעֵ֣מֶק הַפְּגָרִ֣ים׀וְהַדֶּ֡שֶׁן וְכָֽל־הַשְּׁדֵמוֹת֩ עַד־נַ֨חַל קִדְר֜וֹן עַד־פִּנַּ֨ת שַׁ֤עַר הַסּוּסִים֙ מִזְרָ֔חָה קֹ֖דֶשׁ לַֽיהוָ֑ה לֹֽא־יִנָּתֵ֧שׁ וְֽלֹא־יֵהָרֵ֛ס ע֖וֹד לְעוֹלָֽם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And all the valley of the corpses and the fat ashes, and all the fields to [the] Wadi Kidron, to [the] corner of [the] Gate of the Horses toward [the] east, [will be] holy to Yahweh; it will not be uprooted, and it will not be overthrown again forever.

en.L: And the whole valley of the corpses and the ashes, and all the fields as far as the Wadi Kidron, to the corner of the Horse Gate toward the east, [will be] holy to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; it will not be uprooted, and it will not be overthrown again, forever.
en.B: The whole valley of the dead bodies and the ashes, and all the fields out to the Kidron Valley, as far as the corner of the Horse Gate on the east, will be holy to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Never again will it be uprooted or overthrown.
en.R: The whole valley where dead bodies and ashes were thrown, and all the fields as far as the Kidron Valley, east to the corner of the Horse Gate, will belong to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} as a holy place. The city will never again be uprooted or overthrown.

es.L: Y todo el valle de los cadáveres y de las cenizas, y todos los campos hasta el torrente de Cedrón, hasta la esquina de la puerta de los Caballos hacia el oriente, [será] santo {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}; no será arrancado ni derrocado nunca más.
es.B: Todo el valle de los cadáveres y de las cenizas, y todos los campos hasta el valle de Cedrón, hasta la esquina de la puerta de los Caballos al oriente, será santo para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Nunca más será arrancado ni derrocado.
es.R: Todo el valle donde se tiraban los cadáveres y las cenizas, y todos los campos hasta el valle de Cedrón, al oriente hasta la esquina de la puerta de los Caballos, le pertenecerán {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} como un lugar santo. La ciudad nunca más será arrancada ni derrocada.

fr.L: Et toute la vallée des cadavres et des cendres, et tous les champs jusqu’au torrent du Cédron, jusqu’à l’angle de la porte des Chevaux vers l’orient, [seront] consacrés {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ; elle ne sera plus arrachée, et elle ne sera plus renversée, à jamais.
fr.B: Toute la vallée des cadavres et des cendres, et tous les champs jusqu’au torrent du Cédron, jusqu’à l’angle de la porte des Chevaux, à l’est, seront consacrés {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}. Jamais plus elle ne sera arrachée ni renversée.
fr.R: Toute la vallée où l’on jetait les cadavres et les cendres, et tous les champs jusqu’à la vallée du Cédron, à l’est jusqu’à l’angle de la porte des Chevaux, appartiendront {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} comme un lieu saint. Jamais plus la ville ne sera arrachée ni renversée.

sw.L: Na bonde lote la mizoga na la majivu, na mashamba yote mpaka kijito cha Kidroni, mpaka pembe ya Lango la Farasi upande wa mashariki, [litakuwa] takatifu kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; halitang'olewa, wala halitaangushwa tena milele.
sw.B: Bonde lote la maiti na majivu, na mashamba yote hadi Bonde la Kidroni, mpaka pembe ya Lango la Farasi upande wa mashariki, litakuwa takatifu kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Halitang'olewa wala kuangushwa tena kamwe.
sw.R: Bonde lote ambamo maiti na majivu yalitupwa, na mashamba yote mpaka Bonde la Kidroni, mashariki hadi pembe ya Lango la Farasi, vitakuwa mali ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kama mahali patakatifu. Mji hautang'olewa wala kuangushwa tena kamwe.

vi.L: Cả thung lũng của xác chết và tro, cùng mọi cánh đồng cho đến khe Xết-rôn, đến góc Cổng Ngựa về phía đông, [sẽ là] thánh cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; nó sẽ không bị nhổ đi, cũng không bị lật đổ nữa, cho đến đời đời.
vi.B: Cả thung lũng đầy xác chết và tro, cùng mọi cánh đồng ra đến thung lũng Xết-rôn, cho đến góc Cổng Ngựa ở phía đông, sẽ là thánh cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Thành sẽ không bao giờ bị nhổ đi hay bị lật đổ nữa.
vi.R: Cả thung lũng nơi người ta vứt xác chết và tro, cùng mọi cánh đồng ra đến thung lũng Xết-rôn, phía đông đến góc Cổng Ngựa, sẽ thuộc về {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} như một nơi thánh. Thành sẽ không bao giờ bị nhổ đi hay bị lật đổ nữa.

ko.L: 그리고 시체와 재의 온 골짜기와, 기드론 시내까지, 동쪽으로 말 문 모퉁이까지 이르는 모든 밭이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}에게 거룩할 것이다. 그것이 다시는 영원히 뽑히지도 무너지지도 않을 것이다.
ko.B: 시체와 재를 버리던 온 골짜기와, 기드론 골짜기까지, 동쪽으로 말 문 모퉁이까지 이르는 모든 밭이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 거룩한 곳이 될 것이다. 그 성은 다시는 영원히 뽑히지도 무너지지도 않을 것이다.
ko.R: 시체와 재를 내다 버리던 온 골짜기와, 동쪽으로 기드론 골짜기와 말 문 모퉁이까지 이르는 모든 밭이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}에게 속한 거룩한 곳이 될 것이다. 그 성은 다시는 결코 뽑히거나 무너지지 않을 것이다.

pt.L: E todo o vale dos cadáveres e das cinzas, e todos os campos até o ribeiro de Cedrom, até a esquina da Porta dos Cavalos, ao oriente, [serão] santos {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}; não será arrancada e não será arrasada nunca mais, para sempre.
pt.B: Todo o vale dos cadáveres e das cinzas, e todos os campos até o vale do Cedrom, até a esquina da Porta dos Cavalos, a leste, serão santos para {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}. Nunca mais a cidade será arrancada nem arrasada.
pt.R: Todo o vale onde jogavam os cadáveres e as cinzas, e todos os campos até o vale do Cedrom, a leste, até a esquina da Porta dos Cavalos, vão pertencer {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} como um lugar santo. A cidade nunca mais vai ser arrancada nem arrasada.

decisions.choice: the valley of the corpses and the ashes: probably the Valley of Ben-hinnom, south of the city
decisions.reason: Jeremiah said that this valley, where children were sacrificed, would be filled with the dead (7:31-33; 19:6). The ashes are the fatty ashes of burnt sacrifices (Leviticus 1:16; 4:12). The most unclean place around the city will become holy.

decisions.choice: the fields: the reading the scribes marked to be read aloud
decisions.reason: The written Hebrew has a word that looks similar but is otherwise unknown; the marginal note (qere) gives the word for fields or terraces (Deuteronomy 32:32; Isaiah 16:8). The translation follows the marginal reading.

decisions.choice: the Wadi Kidron and the Horse Gate: the eastern side of the city
decisions.reason: The Kidron is the valley east of Jerusalem, below the temple. The Horse Gate was in the east wall near the temple (Nehemiah 3:28; 2 Kings 11:16).

decisions.choice: not uprooted, not overthrown: the words of Jeremiah's call
decisions.reason: The verbs are those of 1:10 and verse 28. The judgment they announced will never come again on the rebuilt city.

decisions.choice: uprooted, overthrown
decisions.reason: Each level keeps the verbs of 1:10.

decisions.choice: will belong to the LORD as a holy place ... The city
decisions.reason: Readable explains "holy to the LORD" and names the city as what will not be uprooted.

decisions.choice: "nhổ đi ... lật đổ"; "Xết-rôn", "Cổng Ngựa"
decisions.reason: The verbs of Jeremiah's call as in verse 28; the place names are the published forms (1 Kings 2:37; 2 Chronicles 23:15).

decisions.choice: "뽑히다 ... 무너지다"
decisions.reason: The words of Jeremiah's call (meaning decision m4), with the same Korean verbs as at 18:7 and 31:28.

decisions.choice: o ribeiro de Cedrom (L), o vale do Cedrom (B, R); arrancada, arrasada
decisions.reason: "Cedrom" as John 18:1 has the name in Portuguese; Literal says "ribeiro" for the wadi, a stream bed, and Balanced and Readable "vale", as the English. The two verbs keep the words of 1:10 (m4): "arrancar", "arrasar".
